name: Peresdacha
source:
Semyon lives an ordinary life. He leaves the house, goes shopping, tries to fix his relationship with his girlfriend. But one day it happens that the girl starts to pay less and less attention to him, which leads to a quarrel. Angry Semyon is going to eat (and maybe drink) the sorrows away, but in the supermarket...

And what happened next, the four gods, preparing to retake the exam on the last night, still haven't come up with.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/38-1-0-4218]Anivisual[/url]]
